objective: Qualify and complete ONE selected project with independent evidence and separate readiness decisions.
other_categories: Bee/Ring require separate graphs from their specs after real-data/media gates.
gate_semantics: verified requires current evidence and independent acceptance; gate_result must be pass. Completed failure evaluation is not a pass.
qualification_semantics: Provisional selection permits qualification; full scope requires applicable access/native/value gates to pass.
mini_challenge: Additional OSS kit proposed; C07 scope changes need explicit selected mini and current rules.

tasks.title: Current rules, evidence and rights ledger
tasks.acceptance: Governing rules refreshed; requirements and rights mapped.

tasks.title: Environment, Git, models and native team audit
tasks.acceptance: Actual host/model/team capability recorded; user work preserved.

tasks.title: Access and 48-hour qualification plan
tasks.acceptance: Actual equipment/participant availability recorded; probes and decision criteria predeclared.

tasks.title: One-project selection record
tasks.acceptance: One active branch; preferred thesis vs confirmed executable choice separated; fatal gates cannot be waived.

tasks.title: Actual native Vega feasibility
tasks.acceptance: Pinned SDK/RN/sample; actual VVD build/run, D-pad and secure relay proof.

tasks.title: Actual phone and independent listener feasibility
tasks.acceptance: Real HTTPS phone mic/lifecycle, independent listener and controlled quality evidence.
tasks.external_dependency: Supported physical phone and consenting second human.

tasks.title: Minimal remote/blind-loop value prototype
tasks.acceptance: Truthful native/phone loop; no intelligibility/treatment verdict; short-bank behavior defined.

tasks.title: Intended-user comparison and value gate
tasks.acceptance: Phone-workflow comparison recorded; actual evidence class explicit; fail/pending blocks full scope.
tasks.external_dependency: Consenting intended-user dyads; clinician perspective where feasible.

tasks.title: Typed state/transport/privacy contract
tasks.acceptance: Roles, expiries, sequence/generation, attempts/windows, payload bounds and hidden-reveal invariants reviewed.

tasks.title: Complete native client and persistence
tasks.acceptance: Six-capability client; remote focus/Back/recovery, literal phrases, minimal history/deletion.

tasks.title: Complete HTTPS phone companion
tasks.acceptance: Ephemeral local analysis, lifecycle states and role-separated response; no hidden leak/raw retention.

tasks.title: Reference and cloud relay adapters
tasks.acceptance: Actual transport validates role/window/message constraints, expiry, bounds and redacted logs.

tasks.title: Integrated blind/reveal and recovery
tasks.acceptance: Real round trip; 1/2/3/10 phrase sessions, late/disconnect/skip and denominator cases.

tasks.title: Metric qualification and independent oracles
tasks.acceptance: Independent fixtures plus randomized physical phone negatives; unsupported metrics removed.

tasks.title: Security/privacy/failure acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Role/room/replay/expiry/malformed/stale failures; no-audio egress/storage/logs, deletion and track shutdown.

tasks.title: Native remote/accessibility acceptance
tasks.acceptance: D-pad/Back/focus/recovery and applicable screen-reader journey; no accessible blind leak.

tasks.title: Independent native/phone end-to-end evidence
tasks.acceptance: Fresh build with actual evidence classes/measurements and defects independently reviewed. Minimum operating/rollback runbook prepared.

tasks.title: Actual MCP and Apps qualification
tasks.acceptance: 2025-11-25 StreamableHTTP lifecycle/tools/resources and actual ui:// sandbox bridge; labelled simulated host.

tasks.title: Borrowing demand and rival gate
tasks.acceptance: Recent contingent-borrowing incidents and simpler-workaround comparison; detailed rival wedge audited.
tasks.external_dependency: Consenting adults with recent relevant borrowing.

tasks.title: Bounded planner/consent/store contracts
tasks.acceptance: Stable IDs/slots/timezone, revision-bound immutable terms, owner roles and store-local invariants.

tasks.title: Local/cloud store and planner
tasks.acceptance: SQLite/DynamoDB invariants; ≤100 distinct transaction items; attach conditions; durable receipts; no external atomicity.

tasks.title: Complete authenticated MCP tools
tasks.acceptance: Plan/propose/approve/decline/commit/resume/cancel/manual checkout-return/export/delete; no approve-all.

tasks.title: Voice-first simulator and actual Apps UI
tasks.acceptance: Borrower/owner exact-term confirmation, useful accessible interaction, persistent simulation disclosure.

tasks.title: Integrated multi-owner workflow
tasks.acceptance: Real calls/state changes over labelled inventory; repair, revision consent, commit and session resume.

tasks.title: Adversarial transaction/auth/UX acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Race, changed/expired/missing approval, durable duplicate receipt, cancel/DST/cross-circle/unknown failures.

tasks.title: Independent MCP/cloud/user evidence
tasks.acceptance: Fresh clean run, actual claimed runtime/AWS calls and protocol/UI/user evidence; no physical guarantee. Minimum operating/rollback runbook prepared.

tasks.title: Independent engineering release review
tasks.acceptance: Only selected branch required; clean setup/build, license/security/privacy and critical/high defects reviewed. Minimum operating/rollback runbook independently verified.
tasks.dependency_policy: Require selected-track dependencies; unselected branch must be not_applicable with selection evidence.

tasks.title: Operations and authorized cloud smoke
tasks.acceptance: Runbook, redaction, state recovery/backup, bounded load and rollback; actual services recorded. Verify actual local or cloud route; cloud smoke applies only to claimed integrations.

tasks.title: Additional reusable OSS contribution
tasks.acceptance: Separate useful licensed kit, interface/examples/meaningful tests and exact contribution fields.

tasks.title: Functional video and submission drafts
tasks.acceptance: Under3min English actual demo/labels; project, feedback, genuine friction, judge instructions and rights.

tasks.title: Final rules/repository/judge access audit
tasks.acceptance: Amendments, source/license/reviewer access, usable free judge route and all fields checked.
tasks.external_dependency: External publication/account actions only within user authorization.

tasks.title: Hackathon-readiness decision
tasks.acceptance: Current selected-branch evidence complete; draft/publication/submission states distinguished.

tasks.title: Real intended-device distribution qualification
tasks.acceptance: Actual target environments/current distribution rules tested; FireTV Appstore needs physical device.
tasks.external_dependency: Physical Fire TV for FireTV production; real intended environment/users.

tasks.title: Public production operations/intended-use acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Actual intended users, privacy/intended-use/accessibility/security, capacity/recovery/support/distribution verified.

tasks.title: Production-readiness decision and handoff
tasks.acceptance: Production label only with real required passes; otherwise exact blockers and resume action.

repair_transitions.action: Open concrete defect/reproducer; repair and retest affected path.
Invalidate affected downstream evidence; reopen acceptance.
Block exact task with missing dependency; continue independent work; do not waive gate.
Read checkpoint, verify checkout/evidence, respawn missing teammates.

stopping_rule: Finish authorized executable work. Preserve checkpoints and truthful external blockers; no false readiness.
readiness_note: Public-production readiness is independent of hackathon form/video readiness; both remain required for full requested scope.
mini_scope_note: C07 mandatory for chosen additional OSS scope; not universal primary-track eligibility.
